description: This file defines the SmsMessageReceiver class, a BroadcastReceiver that listens for incoming SMS messages, processes the message and sender info, queries contact display names, and triggers an activity to display the message details.

classes.name: SmsMessageReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that listens for incoming SMS messages, resolves contact names, and launches an activity to display the message.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles the receipt of SMS messages, extracting message data, querying contact name, and launching a dialog activity to display the message.
